units.source_text: 在他那空空如也的脑子里充满了三弦琴的音响。

en.t: The sound of the shamisen filled his utterly empty mind.

units.source_text: 与其说他是全然感到意外，不如说是完全被征服了。

en.t: Rather than being completely surprised, he was utterly overcome.

units.source_text: 他被虔诚的心所打动，被悔恨的思绪所洗刷了。

en.t: He was moved by a reverent heart and cleansed by thoughts of remorse.

units.source_text: 他感到自己已经没有力气，只好愉快地投身到驹子那艺术魅力的激流之中，任凭它漂浮、冲激。

en.t: He felt he no longer had any strength, and could only gladly throw himself into the torrent of Komako's artistic charm, letting it carry him along and buffet him.
